paragraphs: Ostrander at the 17th Annual Toast of Harwich

In my tribute paintings, I illustrate the unpredictable events we encounter on a daily basis, as well as those that may be seen only once in a lifetime. Events that bring us great joy and celebration, as well as those that end in tragedy. Expressing what authors put into words, I tell stories with paint on paper and canvas.

Ostrander is a member of the Guild of Harwich Artists; The Art Gallery, Harwich Port; The Creative Art Center, Chatham and the Cultural Center of Cape Cod, Yarmouth. Ostrander is an exhibiting artist in The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street, Harwich Port, MA.

In my tribute paintings, I illustrate the unpredictable events we encounter on a daily basis, as well as those that may be seen only once in a lifetime. Events that bring us great joy and celebration, as well as those that end in tragedy. Expressing what authors put into words, I tell stories with paint on paper and canvas.

Ostrander is a member of the Guild of Harwich Artists; The Art Gallery,  Harwich Port; The Creative Art Center, Chatham and the Cultural Center of Cape Cod, Yarmouth.  Ostrander is an exhibiting artist in The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street, Harwich Port, MA.
